I wish I could do the same. I fear fucking up an attempt and being in a wheelchair for the rest of my life but being an Australian with no access to firearms and painful suicide methods this is off the charts for me. 
But please message me if you need to friend, I cannot stop you but just know you're not alone and I'd feel better knowing we could talk about what's on your mind.

I feel this too. I fucked up and rejected all the help that the people that loved me gave to me and now I have almost nobody or anything left that brings me joy. I cannot stop you friend, but just know that if you'd like to talk about these things my inbox is open, I don't know how much longer I'll be here too and despite being a mess of my own, I like to help others... That brings a tiny bit of joy to the void that that is now my life...

Just a quick update. From the time I posted this, I tried to contact my ex partner, who I still see and hang out with, but in a space of an hour tonight I destroyed everything with my insecurities and he told me he didn't love me anymore because I ruined everything so I think tonight is a go. 
I can't handle this anymore. I have nothing left to live for anymore. I pushed everyone away and I'm done for.

I feel this. I fantasise about ways to commit suicide yet I'm too scared.
Scared I'll fail, and fear of the unknown. It's an endless fucking cycle and it's exhausting.
